# AgentX

AgentX is a terminal-based AI agent for building and modifying real web projects.

## Documentation

- Introduction: https://agentx.js.org/docs/intro
- Installation: https://agentx.js.org/docs/installation
- Providers: https://agentx.js.org/docs/providers
- Local Models: https://agentx.js.org/docs/local-models
- Architecture: https://agentx.js.org/docs/architecture
- Commands: https://agentx.js.org/docs/commands
- Stacks: https://agentx.js.org/docs/stacks
- Services: https://agentx.js.org/docs/services
- Security: https://agentx.js.org/docs/security
- FAQ: https://agentx.js.org/docs/faq

## Workflow

AgentX follows a plan -> read -> execute -> verify loop. It is designed to inspect an existing repository before making changes and to use project checks as feedback.

## Install

npm install -g @agent-qofeno/agentx-cli
